title: When searching for an application via keyboard in kickoff, show on each search result the location where to find it
line: Hovering or keyboard-selecting an application in Kickoff's search results now shows a tooltip with the category it is listed in, like "Category: System".
explanation: Kickoff's search results come from KRunner's services runner, whose matches only carry the app's name, icon and generic name or comment, so nothing in the launcher knew which Applications category an app belongs to. Finding it again by browsing meant opening every category. The kicker plugin now has a menuPath role for application search results: it walks the menu tree once (breadth-first, so the least nested entry wins), caches storage id → group captions, and drops the cache when KSycoca changes. Kickoff adds "Category: <top-level group>" to the result's tooltip (Kickoff flattens subcategories, so the top-level group is what the user sees), and shows that tooltip on hover and when the result has keyboard focus.

commits.message:
applets/kicker: expose the menu category of application search results

Search results from the services runner gave no way to tell where an app
can be found when browsing the menu. Add a menuPath role holding the
captions of the menu groups that contain the application.

BUG: 353998

applets/kickoff: show the category of application search results

Nothing told users where a searched app lives in the Applications list,
so finding it again by browsing meant opening every category. Show the
category in the result's tooltip, also when it has keyboard focus.

BUG: 353998

patches.diff:
From c5a142430a6513d41b7b8bf8fa33a810aa2f7150 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 12:20:35 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/kickoff: show the category of application search
 results

Nothing told users where a searched app lives in the Applications list,
so finding it again by browsing meant opening every category. Show the
category in the result's tooltip, also when it has keyboard focus.

BUG: 353998
---
 applets/kickoff/AbstractKickoffItemDelegate.qml | 14 ++++++++++----
 1 file changed, 10 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/kickoff/AbstractKickoffItemDelegate.qml b/applets/kickoff/AbstractKickoffItemDelegate.qml
index bc4fcbae6c..9e67852c88 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/AbstractKickoffItemDelegate.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/AbstractKickoffItemDelegate.qml
@@ -249,15 +249,21 @@ T.ItemDelegate {
     }
 
     PC3.ToolTip.text: {
+        let text = ""
         if (root.labelTruncated) {
-            return model?.display ?? ""
+            text = model?.display ?? ""
         } else if (root.descriptionTruncated || (!root.descriptionVisible && (root.isSearchResult
                                                                               || Plasmoid.configuration.appNameFormat > 1))) {
-            return description
+            text = description
         }
-        return ""
+        const menuPath = root.isSearchResult ? (model?.menuPath ?? []) : []
+        if (menuPath.length > 0) {
+            const category = i18nc("@info:tooltip %1 is the Applications category a search result can be found in", "Category: %1", menuPath[0])
+            text = text.length > 0 ? text + "\n" + category : category
+        }
+        return text
     }
-    PC3.ToolTip.visible: mouseArea.containsMouse && PC3.ToolTip.text.length > 0
+    PC3.ToolTip.visible: (mouseArea.containsMouse || (root.isSearchResult && root.activeFocus && root.focusReason !== Qt.MouseFocusReason)) && PC3.ToolTip.text.length > 0
     PC3.ToolTip.delay: Kirigami.Units.toolTipDelay
 
     background: Loader {
--

media.caption: Master: search "konsole" and hover the Konsole result: no tooltip, nothing says where Konsole is in the Applications list
With the fix, same hover: tooltip "Category: System"
Master: keyboard only (Down into the results, Up back to Konsole): no tooltip
With the fix, same keys: the focused Konsole result shows "Category: System"
Master with the "Name only" format: the hover tooltip shows only the hidden description "Terminal"
With the fix: the tooltip shows the description and, below it, "Category: System"
